subject: Abstract sparkline-silhouette motif, no axes or numbers. Two flowing signal lines on an otherwise empty canvas. A coral line starts earliest (furthest left) and climbs steadily and confidently the full width of the canvas, ending in a focal dot with a halo ring at the upper right, the 80HE+ preorder moment. A muted warm-grey dashed line enters later, close to where the coral line already sits mid-climb (hardware has nearly caught up), then flattens out, so the vertical gap between the two signals widens left to right instead of closing, the firmware/software maturity gap. A low-opacity coral wash fills the wedge between the two lines, the widening gap itself as the visual subject.
motif: sparkline silhouette, twin ascending signal lines with a widening gap wash
strokeWeight: 2px (3px on the primary coral signal line)
background: transparent (light-mode safe; warm-grey stroke family legible on both charcoal oklch(0.175 0.006 250) and light paper)
notes: Per bearings.md 'Article hero art', trends pieces get a sparkline silhouette mapped to the Trends Tracker's score-over-time visual language. Deliberately avoids the axis-tick/baseline convention used in earlier trend hero art (e.g. hall-effect-rapid-trigger-plateau.svg) per this brief's explicit instruction to keep it an abstract silhouette shape, not a literal chart. Coral line node points (110,520) (280,460) (450,380) (620,320) (790,260) (960,210) (1090,175) rendered as a single smooth cubic-bezier path with S-command continuation; three sparse release-cadence dots at the interior nodes; focal dot + halo ring at the terminal node. Muted line node points (380,430) (520,410) (680,390) (830,372) (980,358) (1090,345), same bezier technique, dash-dotted stroke, open-ring entry marker, muted trailing dot. Gap wash is a straight-line polygon sampling both curves at x = 380/520/680/830/980/1090 (Wooting curve y-values interpolated piecewise-linearly between its bezier node points for this sampling only; the stroked curve itself is the smooth bezier), coral fill at 9% opacity, sits beneath both strokes. Bronze theme dot at (1132,60) matches the family ornamental anchor. All XML comments use single hyphens only (no '- -' runs), verified with a Node double-hyphen scan and a python xml.dom.minidom parse before delivery, per the svg-validity.test.ts regression guard.
warnings: No local Playwright/resvg preview render was available in this session to visually QA the composition; geometry was hand-verified (bezier continuity, coordinate bounds, wash polygon closure) and the file was checked for XML well-formedness before delivery.
